newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: World air cargo traffic up 4.6 pct in August - ACI.
newsitem.headline: World air cargo traffic up 4.6 pct in August - ACI.

text.p: Freight and mail traffic handled by 483 airports around the world in August 1996, totalled 4.18 million tonnes, up 4.6 percent on the same month the previous year, said Geneva-based Airports Council International (ACI).
North America, the biggest of ACI's six cargo-handling regions, reported 2.20 million tonnes of freight traffic, up 4.4 percent on August 1995.

Airports in the Asia/Pacific region (in which ACI incorporates Indo-China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, Thailand, Japan, Malaysia and Australia), handled 842,892 tonnes, an increase of 6.9 percent on August last year, ACI said.
August 1996 cargo traffic handled at ACI's Europe member airports totalled 781,195 tonnes, a rise of 3.9 percent on the same month in 1995.
Middle East airports' cargo rose 4.7 percent to 221,925 tonnes while Latin America/Caribbean airports' saw a 7.8 percent growth in freight traffic volume on August 1995 to 104,163 tonnes.
African airports handled 26,744 tonnes a decline of 23.6 percent on the same period a year ago.
